(2) `startLanePreview(lane, goalId, sha)` — POSTs `preview.start` on `mintLaneOperatorSeat(lane)` (the lane credential is NOT the operator principal and is correctly refused `OPERATOR_PRINCIPAL_REQUIRED @ DAEMON_AUTHORIZATION`), payload EXACTLY `{goalId, sha}` (`PREVIEW_START_PAYLOAD_KEYS`; an extra key is refused by the ingress allow-list). (4) `readActivityVerdict(lane, goalId)` — POSTs `/activity/read` with `{goalRef: goalId}` and returns the entries, so an arm can assert the verdict from the daemon's answer rather than from component state.
